text: one was make-shift, the other a real observatory
Going by know thy quizmaster. Hyderabad?
this dilapidated structure participated in the Carte du Ciel project
It participated in the Carte du Ciel making 463,542 observations. It boasted of an 8" Cooke Astrograph and a 15" Grubb refractor telescope. At the time the biggest telescope in all of Asia.

Back then Punjagutta (where it is located) was outside the city limits. But now it is a bustling neighborhood with lots of light pollution. The observatory was moved to a village outside Hyderabad a few decades ago.
